summary: Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary Athena Funding III LLC entered into a Loan Financing and Servicing Agreement to secure a revolving credit facility. The facility has an initial maximum principal of $150 million, expandable to $250 million, with borrowing base and collateral quality tests. Borrowings bear interest at SOFR plus 2.10% per annum. Proceeds will finance eligible asset origination and acquisition. The registrant retains a residual interest. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation.
